preconditions.description: The number of glades n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The number of trails m must be between 0 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in trails)
preconditions.description: Each trail must connect glades with valid indices between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' if all(degree % 2 == 0 for degree in degrees) and is_connected else str(min_trails_to_add)
postconditions.description: If all glades have even degrees and the graph is connected, output 0; otherwise, output the minimum number of trails to add.
